edits.before:
Clear details before work is arranged.

1. Tell us what you have noticed

Share the property suburb or address, the room or area affected, what you can see, hear or smell, and when the issue began. Photos can be helpful when they can be taken safely.

2. Include access and approval information

For managed properties, include the tenant or on-site contact, access notes, work-order reference and the person responsible for approvals. This helps us understand the practical context of the request.

3. Confirm scope and written quote

Our local team arranges an on-site assessment, identifies the fault or installation requirements and confirms the scope and written quote. We arrange the appropriately qualified trades for specialist or regulated work and confirm the responsible contractor and documentation before booking.
edits.after:
Assessment, quotation and repair booking

Start with the property address, the repair or installation required and the contact who can arrange entry. For managed properties, include the work-order reference and the person authorised to approve costs. Our team arranges the assessment and confirms the work and price in a written quote before work proceeds.

Additional findings are explained before extra work is added. The responsible contractor, relevant qualifications and documentation are confirmed for specialist or regulated work before booking. The property maintenance service explains how plumbing and electrical tasks are recorded and approved together.
